## Midterm Vignette

As mentioned in class during Week 7, this dataset was actually the first dataset brainstormed among the instructors for pre-approved Midterm $\rightarrow$ Final Project purposes! We mention this here because, it represents a rare instance where we can actually analyze **real** data from a real company's backend DB, rather than having to *simulate* it (as in the [healthcare example](./healthcare.qmd)).

The most widely-studied version of this dataset contains about [**500,000 emails**](https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~enron/), released to the public as part of the litigation over Enron's prosecution for accounting fraud by the US [Federal Bureau of Investigation](https://www.fbi.gov/history/cases-and-criminals/enron) and Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.
